name: B2B CRM (Lead-Centric)
description: Lead-centric B2B CRM with lead qualification, conversion to Account/Contact/Opportunity, campaigns, and pipeline management — Salesforce-style on WaymakerOS

sections.name: Lead Management
sections.purpose: Capture, qualify, and convert leads into accounts, contacts, and opportunities

sections.name: Opportunity Pipeline
sections.purpose: Kanban board tracking opportunities through sales stages

sections.name: Campaigns
sections.purpose: Track marketing campaigns with lead source attribution and ROI

sections.name: Activities & Calls
sections.purpose: Log calls, emails, meetings linked to leads and opportunities

sections.name: Sales Dashboard
sections.purpose: Pipeline value, lead conversion rates, campaign ROI, and forecasting

design.colorPalette: Enterprise — navy (#001126) primary, gold (#A49886) accent, blue (#3D5B6C) secondary, sand (#F5F5F0) background

what_you_build: A lead-centric B2B CRM with qualification workflow, opportunity pipeline, and campaign tracking. Replaces Salesforce.
starter_prompt: I want to build a lead-centric CRM using the WaymakerOS CRM B2B Lead blueprint. Use host_blueprint_get with blueprint_id "crm-b2b-lead" to get the full blueprint, then guide me through building it.
seo_title: Lead Management CRM Template — Build with AI | WaymakerOS
